column1: # Findings that are known, understood and cannot be fixed here yet.
# A suppressed finding is NOT hidden. It still appears in the digest, in its own
# section, with the reason and the date it must be looked at again. What it does
# not do is hold the issue open: an issue that can never close stops being a
# signal, which is the same disease as one that lists successes.
# The review date is the part that matters. A suppression with no expiry is a
# silent pin, which is how this estate ended up carrying a lintian override that
# had suppressed nothing for ten days. After the date passes the finding counts
# again and the issue reopens, so the worst case is being asked a second time
# key is the advisory id for audit and alert rows, the setting name for cover
# rows, and the pull request number for pr rows.
